gizmo.title: Hero
gizmo.description: A large image, GIF or video with a heading and text over it, placed anywhere in a page.

configure.title: Image or video
configure.description: A JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4 or WebM file.

configure.title: Alternative text
configure.description: Describe the image. Leave empty when it is only decoration.

configure.title: Heading
configure.description: Heading shown over the media. Leave empty for none.

configure.title: Text
configure.description: Text shown under the heading, over the media.

configure.title: Full width
configure.description: Run edge to edge instead of sitting in the content column.

configure.title: Framing
configure.description: How the photo sits at each screen size

advanced.title: Fade
advanced.description: Color laid over the media. With a heading or text there is always one, so the text stays readable.

advanced.title: Focal point across
advanced.description: Part of the image that stays in view when it is cropped, from 0 (left) to 100 (right).

advanced.title: Focal point down
advanced.description: Part of the image that stays in view when it is cropped, from 0 (top) to 100 (bottom).

demoSchema.content: Tour the research plots and meet the graduate students.
